purpose: Machine-readable path map for new-project adaptation. Human guide: docs/orchestration/PROJECT_MAP.md (+ .ko.md). Consumed by `./orchestrate init` to print the adaptation checklist for either backend.

orchestration-core.action: keep — required for the agent system to run

template-dev-only.action: safe to delete in a real research project

notes.tests/: validates the template's own orchestration system; keep only if you want to re-verify the system after modifying it
notes..github/: the template's distribution CI; replace with your project's CI
notes.docs/: template usage guides (docs/orchestration/); delete after reading or keep as reference

adapt-and-rewrite.action: keep the file, truncate/rewrite its content for the new project

README.ko.md.advice: replace with your project's Korean README (or delete)

LICENSE.advice: set your project's license and holder

requirements.txt.advice: replace with your project's dependencies (single file; drop pytest lines if you delete tests/)

plan/PRD.md.advice: fill in your project's PRD with the orchestrator

plan/CHECKLIST.md.advice: fill in your project's checklist with the orchestrator
